Chunk up datasets ready to send to FR geoserver

Chunking the datasets will allow the app to be run in shiny.io


```{r Get tiles for chunking datasets}

# Get list of RDS files
rds_tiled_poly_files <- list.files(tile_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
# Read in tiles
tiles_list <- lapply(rds_tiled_poly_files, readRDS)
#name tiles with tile_id
names(tiles_list) <- sapply(tiles_list, function(x) unique(x$tile_ID))
#name tiles with tile_id
# filter ew10k for matching tile_name
selected_tiles <- ew10k[ew10k$tile_name %in% names(tiles_list), ]
missing_tiles <- ew10k[!ew10k$tile_name %in% names(tiles_list), ]

```

```{r}
#which tiles are missing?

# The missing tile IDs
#These tiles don't contain NFI woodlands
missing_tiles <- c("SN36", "SS75", "SW81", "SX14", "SY38", "TR33")

# Add a column to flag missing tiles
ew10k$missing <- ifelse(ew10k$tile_name %in% missing_tiles, "Missing", "Present")

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ew10k, aes(fill = missing), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Present" = "white", "Missing" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "EW 10k Tiles — Missing vs Present",
       fill = "Tile Status")

```

```{r Custom 200km grid square shapefile}

#The 10km chunks are too small for Andrew to upload to the geoserver

#CEH land cover map 2023
lcm <- raster("~/iDeer/data/raw-data/lcm-2023/gblcm2023_25m.tif")

#focal1000 dams raster
dams <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/OneDrive - University of Southampton/R_data_transfer/Amy-iDeer-tool/data/data/focal_DAMS_1000m.tif")

res <- 200000 # change this to something which splits the country into the desired 4-5 sections.
e <- ext(lcm) #lcm = template raster

# Manually extend to ensure full coverage
x_seq <- seq(e[1], e[2] + res, by = res)
y_seq <- seq(e[3], e[4] + res, by = res)

# Create polygons
grid_polys <- list()
id <- 1

for (i in seq_along(x_seq[-length(x_seq)])) {
  for (j in seq_along(y_seq[-length(y_seq)])) {
    x1 <- x_seq[i]; x2 <- x_seq[i+1]
    y1 <- y_seq[j]; y2 <- y_seq[j+1]
    coords <- matrix(c(x1,y1, x2,y1, x2,y2, x1,y2, x1,y1), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)
    grid_polys[[id]] <- vect(list(coords), type = "polygons", crs = as.character(crs(lcm)))
    id <- id + 1
  }
}

# Combine into a single SpatVector
grid <- do.call(rbind, grid_polys)

# Optional: assign IDs
grid$id <- seq_len(nrow(grid))

#Give tiles names
grid$tile_name <- paste0("tile_", seq_len(nrow(grid)))
names(grid)

grid <- st_as_sf(grid)
st_crs(grid) <- 27700 #ignore warning, crs is correct

# Save as ESRI Shapefile (creates .shp + associated files)
st_write(grid, "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/custom_grid_200km.shp", overwrite = TRUE)

# Plot geometries
plot(grid$geometry, main = "Custom 200km Grid", col = "lightblue", border = "grey40")
plot(lcm, add=TRUE)

plot(grid$geometry, main = "Custom 200km Grid", col = "lightblue", border = "grey40")
plot(dams, add=TRUE)

##

```
